detail: Full summary: Effect decomposition from the pooled run is decisive about where value comes from: orientation (+5.9, 1.2 calls/sess) and recording (+5.9, 1.7 calls/sess) are the ENTIRE measured effect. graph_building, verification, coordination_mgmt, search_retrieval, lifecycle and decision_mgmt all show 0.0 calls and no heavy users. 30 tools were never called once across ~200 sessions.
